default.comment: Quiet outlines and dividers: an input's edge, a card, a separator.

interactive.comment: The stronger outline of buttons and other controls you press.

selected.comment: The outline of a selected card or option. Pair it with a colour change, never colour alone.

indicator.comment: Bars that mark the current item, such as an active tab or navigation link.

halo.comment: The soft ring around a focused input, drawn with box-shadow.
